result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, and cards are well aligned with good contrast. The main visual defect is a duplicate carousel card showing the same restaurant twice.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards (same image, name, 15-25 min, €0.90 delivery) appear consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, which looks like a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry from the 'Fastest near you' list so each restaurant appears only once, or de-duplicate the feed data source.
